title: A Fredholm cubic family
promptMarkdown: Let $H=\ell^2(\mathbb N;\mathbb R)$, fix $a\in H$, and define $F:H\times\mathbb R\to H\times\mathbb R$ by $F(x,t)=(x,t^3-t+\langle x,a\rangle)$. Prove it is smooth Fredholm of index zero. Determine its critical-value set and the number of points in every regular fibre. Explain the finite-dimensional reduction and why the regular-value set is open dense here, without claiming an infinite-dimensional Lebesgue measure.
hintLadder: Eliminate the cross term in the derivative by a target-coordinate change.
Find the critical points of $t^3-t$ and evaluate the cubic there.
Draw the monotonicity intervals and count roots, including the equality boundary separately.
